role: Display-time translator for the Help Center: looks each English Help string up by its exact English text in the separate 'Help' string table of the app-language bundle, with a {token} template formatter and a test-only key recorder; plus `localized` projections for HelpCategory/HelpArticle/ArticleSection.
state: mem:HelpLocalization.formattedTexts OSAllocatedUnfairLock<Set<String>> — every text format() has handed out (already translated and filled), so the localized pass passes it through; grows by a handful of age-personalised strings per age and language
mem:HelpLocalization.recorder OSAllocatedUnfairLock<Set<String>?> — nil in the app, a set while a test records lookups
toplevel: Static let initialisers: table name 'Help', formattedTexts lock initialised empty, recorder lock initialised to nil (recording off).

units.does: Translates one English Help string: if it is a text format() already handed out (formattedTexts) returns it unchanged and does not record it; otherwise records the key when a test has recording on, then returns LanguageManager.appBundle.localizedString(forKey: english, value: english, table: 'Help'), i.e. the English itself when the table lacks the key.

branches.cond: english is a text format() handed out
branches.effect: returned as is, not recorded; otherwise recorded (if recording) and looked up, falling back to the English

units.does: Translates an English {token} template via string(), substitutes each values entry for '{key}', remembers the result in formattedTexts (so the later localized pass passes it through untouched) and returns it with no marker character.
Turns key recording on by setting the recorder lock's state to an empty set.
Returns the set of recorded Help lookup keys and turns recording off (sets state back to nil).

branches.cond: keys ?? [] — recorder state is nil (recording was never started)
branches.effect: returns an empty set; otherwise returns the recorded set

units.does: Returns a copy of the category with title translated via HelpLocalization.string and every article mapped through HelpArticle.localized; id, icon and color unchanged.
Returns a copy of the article with title and summary translated via HelpLocalization.string and every section mapped through ArticleSection.localized.
Returns the section with every user-visible string passed through HelpLocalization.string (labels and values of keyValue pairs both translated); divider returned unchanged.

branches.effect: returns .keyValue with label and value of each pair translated
